verdict.rationale: This story is about file-system/document-provider interoperability (e.g., iOS Files app / Android storage access framework integration with other apps' sandboxes), which is not a relevant axis for GitHub Mobile—a cloud-based Git/PR management app that doesn't operate on local sandboxed files shared across apps. No evidence pack content addresses this, and the product's nature (cloud repos, not local file management) makes this a category error.
